Name: Found Ladder and Shaft Notification Sound
Author: nicoconot
Description:
Are you tired of placing staircases in the mines only to find out you already discovered a ladder or shaft without noticing it, or the level preloaded with a ladder? Then hopefully this mod is for you!

Note: This mod has just been released, please consider checking under "Possible issues" for things I need help testing out!

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size][b][size=1]
[/size][/b][list]
[*](Optional) Plays a sound and notification whenever you load into a new mine/skull cavern level and there are any preloaded ladders or shafts.
[*]Plays a sound and notification whenever you discover a new ladder or shaft, be it by breaking stones or slaying monsters.
[/list]
[size=5][b]Options[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Check for mine ladders on level load:[/b] When turned on, you will be notified of preloaded ladders/shafts when entering a new mine level.
[*][b]Play notification sound:[/b] Whether to play a sound or not when discovering ladders/shafts.
[*][b]Show notification message:[/b] Whether to show a notification in the bottom-left of the screen when discovering ladders/shafts.
[/list][b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*](Optional) Install the latest version of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[b][size=4]Known issues/annoying things[/size][/b]

[list]
[*]Nothing! The mod is perfect <3[size=1]                   (probably not. kindly let me know about any issues you find!)[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Possible issues[/size][/b]

[list]
[*]There is a possible performance issue when using this mod along with several others, since it does some checks on update ticks(although I've tried to keep those to a minimum).
[*]This mod has been completely untested on multiplayer, and it is likely some issues may arise(such as duplicate notifications).
[/list]
[b][size=4]Mod compatibility[/size][/b]

[list]
[*]I have over 20 mods installed and noticed no issues so far, but mods that change the contents of the mines are likely to cause issues. For advanced users, things to look out for are any changes in the locations of tile index 173 in the mines tilemap and 173/174 in the desert mines tilemap(the tiles that represent ladders and shafts). Visual changes shouldn't cause issues. If monster generation is affected, this mod will probably break as well.
[/list][size=4][b]Roadmap[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Anything under "Known issues".
[*]Adding official multiplayer support.
[*]MAYBE adding translation support, if someone asks.
[/list]

[size=4][b]Issues or suggestions?[/b] Please feel free to contact me here on Nexus!
[/size]
[size=4]Source code: [url=https://github.com/Nicoconot/StaircaseFound-for-StardewValley]Github[/url][/size]

Downloads.Description:
Mod download. Installation instructions:



1. Install the latest version of SMAPI.



2. Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.



3. (Optional) Install the latest version of the Generic Mod Config Menu﻿.



4. Run the game using SMAPI.

Manifest.Name: Found Ladder Notification Sound
Manifest.Description: A simple mod that notifies you when you find a ladder or shaft when mining with an obvious sound and message(optional). You can also enable a notification for when a mine level already has a staircase.
